tagline.en: Travel eSIM inside a Singapore-licensed wallet, valid for 10 years
tagline.zh: 新加坡持牌钱包里的旅行 eSIM，10 年有效

description.en: dtcpay is a Singapore Major Payment Institution licensed by MAS (PS20200531, operated by Digital Treasures Center Pte Ltd) offering stablecoin, card and transfer services; its app also includes a travel eSIM line with data plans for 158+ countries, officially promoted with 10-year validity, no throttling and reuse across devices. Leftover data can be shared with others or converted into vouchers for future purchases. Community reports (2026-10, unofficial) describe a recurring free-claim promo: a $10 eSIM claimed at USD 0 via the App's eSIM menu, valid up to 10 years, occasionally stackable — official pages do not publish this promo's terms, so treat it as an in-app campaign that may change at any time.

details.en:
## How to claim (community route)

Download the dtcpay app, register and complete KYC (full Chinese-mainland documents are reported to work), then open the eSIM tab → tap + in the top right → slide to pay USD 0 → claim. The installation QR code appears in-app; eSIM-capable devices activate directly. Official device-compatibility docs cover iPhone XS onwards, recent Samsung/Google/Huawei/Oppo/Xiaomi models — with the standing caveat that iPhones purchased in mainland China, Hong Kong and Macao may not support eSIM.

## What it is — and is not

The eSIM is a data-only line: no phone number, no calls, no SMS. Community field tests describe the free tier's Singapore-routed data as a clean residential-grade IP, useful for registration-dependent services, but this is a single-source observation, not a carrier guarantee. The eSIM rides on a payment app: using it means opening a dtcpay account, and future top-ups happen inside the same wallet. The promo's recurrence and stacking rules are App-controlled and can change without notice.

## Operator background

dtcpay is a brand of Digital Treasures Center Pte Ltd, a MAS Major Payment Institution (PS20200531) also holding a Luxembourg CSSF e-money licence per third-party coverage — the payment side is regulated; the eSIM side is a standard resale product, not a carrier licence.
details.zh:
## 领取路径（社区实测）

下载 dtcpay App，注册并完成 KYC（社区口径：全套中国大陆资料可开户），然后底部【eSIM】→ 右上角 + → 滑动支付 USD 0 → 领取成功。安装二维码在 App 内展示，支持 eSIM 的设备可直接激活。官方兼容性文档覆盖 iPhone XS 起及近年三星/谷歌/华为/OPPO/小米机型——并明确提示中国大陆、香港、澳门购买的 iPhone 可能不支持 eSIM。

## 它是什么、不是什么

这张 eSIM 是纯数据线：没有号码、不能通话、不能收短信。社区实测称免费档的新加坡出口流量是较纯净的住宅级 IP，适合依赖注册的服务使用——但这是单源观察，不构成运营商承诺。eSIM 挂在支付 App 下：用它就要开 dtcpay 账户，后续充值也在同一钱包内完成。活动的可重复性与叠加规则由 App 控制，随时可能调整。

## 运营方背景

dtcpay 是 Digital Treasures Center Pte Ltd 旗下品牌，持 MAS 大型支付机构牌照（PS20200531），第三方报道称另持卢森堡 CSSF 电子货币牌照——支付侧受监管；eSIM 侧是常规转售产品，不是运营商牌照业务。
